tasks.title: Scaffold the React and TypeScript PWA toolchain
tasks.description: Create the Vite 8, React 19, and TypeScript 6 project with the dependency versions in PRD section 6.1. Configure hash-routable index.html, strict TypeScript project references, ESLint 10 with typescript-eslint 8, Prettier, Vitest 5 with jsdom, and Playwright 1.64 with desktop, tablet-landscape, and phone projects. Add scripts dev, build, preview, lint, typecheck, test, test:coverage, and test:e2e, where test:e2e builds before running Playwright. Render a minimal strict-mode App with a smoke test. Do not add feature screens, the board, PWA registration, or CI workflows.

requirements: FND-FR-01: Boot a React 19 and TypeScript single-page app with hash routes for the shelf, case board, capture, recall, settings, and a not-found screen; lazy-load every feature screen behind the composition root.
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke test renders the app with accessible text and no console error
npm run build emits a static dist without TypeScript errors
Vitest runs only tests under tests/ and fails when the named file is missing
Playwright config defines desktop 1440x900, tablet-landscape 1280x800, and phone 390x844 projects
constraints: FND-CON-01: Only the lazy board chunk may import pixi.js; the app shell must not include PixiJS in its initial JavaScript payload.

tasks.title: Add installable PWA manifest, icons, and update prompt
tasks.description: Configure vite-plugin-pwa in prompt mode with a same-origin manifest, relative start_url and scope, standalone display, any orientation, and 192px, 512px, and maskable 512px PNG icons generated from public/icons/icon.svg by scripts/generate-icons.mjs using sharp. Register the service worker from src/pwa.ts, import it from src/main.tsx, and mount the UpdatePrompt toast from src/App.tsx with Refresh and Later actions. The prompt must call updateServiceWorker(true) only after explicit confirmation. Precache the app shell and allow future wasm and traineddata assets. Do not enable skipWaiting or claim offline verification yet.

requirements: FND-FR-02: Provide an installable PWA manifest with 192px, 512px, and maskable icons, an app-shell service worker, and an explicit update prompt that never activates a new version during an unsaved edit.
VIS-FR-01: Deliver one installable, offline-first PWA whose app shell and bundled OCR assets load without a network after the first successful load.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest tests assert name, short_name, relative start_url and scope, standalone display, theme colors, and 192/512/maskable icons that exist on disk

No runtime asset in the manifest points to a third-party origin
constraints: VIS-CON-07: At runtime load only same-origin static assets; bundle OCR worker, wasm, and English traineddata so OCR works offline without a download.

tasks.title: Build the hash-routed shell with error and offline states
tasks.description: Replace the placeholder App with HashRouter and a lazy route table for /, /case/:caseId, /case/:caseId/capture, /case/:caseId/recall, /settings, and *. Export AppRoutes so tests can use MemoryRouter. Add AppShell with a compact top bar, content region, storage/offline status slot, an ErrorBoundary that logs no user content and offers Reload and Back to shelf, an OfflineNotice bound to online/offline events, and a recoverable not-found screen. Until later features land, the four screens render clearly labeled placeholders from src/app/placeholders.tsx. Do not implement data loading or feature UI.

tasks.title: Build the standalone visual-direction style tile
tasks.description: Create prototype/style-tile.html and prototype/style-tile.css as a dependency-free, file-URL-openable page with three labeled directions. Each direction shows a cork surface, three pin styles, a red association string, a dashed amber provenance string, a period heading over system body text, and one 44px control. Include a short legend explaining what the reviewer should judge. Use only local CSS, inline SVG, and system or bundled font stacks; no network requests, external images, or external fonts. Add a Playwright test that opens the file URL and asserts the three directions, both string types, the type samples, and no horizontal overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844.

tasks.title: Define validated case domain records
tasks.description: Create Zod schemas and TypeScript types for CaseRecord, CardRecord, ConnectionRecord, AttachmentRecord, Viewport, and CaseSummary. tasks.title: Implement the Dexie schema and repositories
tasks.description: Create a Dexie v1 database with cases, cards, connections, and attachments tables and the indexes needed by the shelf and board: cases by updatedAt and examDate, cards by caseId and caseId+type, connections by caseId and a unique pairKey, attachments by cardId and cardId+kind. Preserve isDemo, backupPromptedAt, tags, OCR fields when present, viewport, and closure metadata. Use one read-write transaction per mutation, validate on read and write, and expose an in-memory fake for tests. Do not import React, fetch, or feature modules.

tasks.title: Add persistent storage, quota display, and multi-tab refresh

tasks.title: Implement validated image import and atomic card creation
tasks.description: Build imageValidation.ts to check the 30 MB limit, JPEG/PNG/WebP magic bytes, MIME compatibility, and decodability. Extend CaseRepository with createCardWithAttachments so the card and three Blobs commit in one transaction. Add cardImport.ts to orchestrate validation, processing, and persistence with abort and cleanup. Do not add the crop UI or capture route.
